card.name: LOGY ending CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY
card.fires_on: The final piece "LOGY" of the capitalized section name CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY, inside parenthetical cross-references like "(see CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY)" in drug labels.

modes.label: Cross-reference to section
modes.description: LOGY completes CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY in a "see ..." pointer, often followed by a closing parenthesis or a subsection name.
modes.example: Avoid consumption of alcohol with Diltiazem Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules (see CLINICAL PHARMACO<<LOGY>> ).

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens; it mildly lowers prescription-related words, which does not matter here.
card.plain: It lights up on the last part of the heading "CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY" when a label points the reader to that section.
